purpose: Teach: 惣菜/祇園/ビリヤード/ツバメ/炭水化物/クールビズ/高島屋/芸者

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんが惣菜を買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your mom picked up some ready-made side dishes for us.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Gentle delivery, the tone of sharing a small kindness. Slight soft smile in the voice, noticing this detail matters to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと祇園に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to Gion with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, direct request. Open and eager without being demanding. The kind of simple honesty a child offers when he trusts the answer will matter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家族でビリヤードしましょうって
lines.en: Sho, Dad suggested we all play billiards together.
lines.style: Warm, inviting. Soft delivery — offering something she's relaying, not commanding. A gentle hand extended toward an experience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ツバメの赤ちゃん見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a baby swallow today.
lines.style: Small, genuine excitement. Not performed — a real observation shared with someone he's comfortable with. Voice bright but not loud, like he's sharing something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが炭水化物を減らす食事を始められたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's started eating less carbs lately.
lines.style: Observant, gentle. Speaking as if noticing something she's silently been watching. Quiet pride in his effort, offered without making a big thing of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがクールビズの夏服を着てらしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw Dad wearing his summer cool-biz outfit today.
lines.style: Small-voiced pride. He's noticed something his father is doing, and sharing it feels important. The simple joy of recognizing someone you care about making an effort.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと高島屋でお買い物しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, shall we go shopping at Takashimaya together soon?
lines.style: Warm invitation, the tone of someone offering a small adventure. Tender but not coddling — including him as a real person she wants beside her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、京都で芸者さんを見たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to see a geisha in Kyoto.
lines.style: Direct, warm wish. The certainty of a child with someone he trusts. Open and clear about what he wants, knowing she'll listen.
